_comment: Oracle cases. expected_total is the score from IRCC's official 'Check your score' tool (canada.ca). Language fields are [speaking, listening, reading, writing] CLB. A case with expected_total null is a persona stub: the test SKIPS it until someone runs the profile through the official tool and pastes the number here. Never guess expected_total.

cases.note: Single, age 23, Canadian bachelor's, CLB 10+ all abilities, 1 year Canadian work, no second language. Canadian post-secondary education adds 30 additional points. Confirmed 474 on the official IRCC 'Check your score' tool 2026-08-21.
